SEARCH
Package org.smtlib

Interface ISolver

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractSolver, Solver_altergo, Solver_bitwuzla, Solver_cvc5, Solver_simplify, Solver_smt, Solver_smtinterpol, Solver_test, Solver_yices2, Solver_z3_2_11, Solver_z3_4_3, Solver_z3_4_3_2, Solver_z3_recent
public interface ISolver
This is the interface to be implemented by any solver adapter; there is a method for each SMT-LIB command.

    • get_assertions

      IResponse get_assertions()
      Returns the list of formulae in the current assertion set, in the order they were asserted. Requires :produce-assertions to be enabled; returns an error if it is not. SMT-LIB does not stipulate the order of the terms in the returned list.
      Returns:
      a sequence of asserted terms, unsupported, or an SMT error response

    • get_proof

      IResponse get_proof()
      Returns a proof of unsatisfiability for the current assertion set. Requires :produce-proofs to be enabled; returns an error if it is not.
      Returns:
      a proof, unsupported, or an SMT error response

    • get_model

      IResponse get_model()
      Returns a satisfying model for the current assertion set. Requires :produce-models to be enabled and the last check-sat to have returned sat; returns an error if these preconditions are not met.
      Returns:
      a model, unsupported, or an SMT error response

    • get_unsat_assumptions

      IResponse get_unsat_assumptions()
      Returns the subset of check-sat-assuming assumptions that caused the result to be unsat. Requires :produce-unsat-assumptions to be enabled; returns an error if it is not.
      Returns:
      a list of assumption literals, unsupported, or an SMT error response

    • get_unsat_core

      IResponse get_unsat_core()
      Returns the named formulae that form an unsatisfiable core of the current assertion set. Requires :produce-unsat-cores to be enabled; returns an error if it is not.
      Returns:
      a list of formula names, unsupported, or an SMT error response

    • get_value

      IResponse get_value(IExpr... terms)
      Returns the values of the given expressions in the current satisfying model. Requires :produce-models to be enabled and the last check-sat to have returned sat; returns an error if these preconditions are not met.
      Parameters:
      terms - expressions to evaluate
      Returns:
      a list of term–value pairs, unsupported, or an SMT error response

    • get_assignment

      IResponse get_assignment()
      Returns the truth-value assignments for all named Boolean formulae in the current model. Requires :produce-assignments to be enabled and the last check-sat to have returned sat; returns an error if these preconditions are not met.
      Returns:
      a list of name–Boolean pairs, unsupported, or an SMT error response

    • get_option

      IResponse get_option(IExpr.IKeyword option)
      Returns the current value of the named option.
      Parameters:
      option - the keyword naming the option
      Returns:
      the option value, or unsupported, or an SMT error response

    • get_info

      IResponse get_info(IExpr.IKeyword option)
      Returns the value of the named info item.
      Parameters:
      option - the info keyword
      Returns:
      the info value, or unsupported, or an SMT error response
